Game Overview

At its heart, Flappy Sprunki is a casual game about guide a lovable creature through a maze of obstacles in Flappy Sprunki. With simple tapping controls, master precision timing to navigate daunting pipes, overcome increasing speeds, and collect power-ups. Challenge your reflexes and strive to outscore your friends in this endless, addictive adventure. Are you ready to soar?
